reviews.text: They were very kind and helpful with things like dropping off our dog. Our dog (9 months old, Jack Russell Terrier) didn't seem to get along very well with the other dogs, perhaps because he wasn't paired with any that he could play with, or maybe he was nervous because it was his first time, or maybe he'd never been indoors for so long before. He didn't eat much, and when we went to pick him up, he seemed scared and huddled up. We brought a few things for him to chew on to keep him entertained, but some of them weren't returned. I recommend bringing things that you don't mind losing. During his stay, we asked them to trim his nails and trim his paw pads. The trimming did a great job, leaving a nice, clean look to his paws. Thank you.

Thank you for your grooming service.
It was my first time getting my dog ​​groomed, so I was very nervous, but the groomer was so kind and careful that I was able to leave him in their care with peace of mind. My whole family was very happy with the results, so I am posting this with gratitude. I could tell that you take good care of my dog, and that you also value his personality (my dog ​​is quite wary), so I would definitely like to ask you to do my grooming again next time. Every time we see my dog, the whole family keeps repeating "So cute!", thinking, "Grooming makes him even cuter!"

I entrusted my 5-month-old puppy to their socialization training program. I was worried because it was his first time staying away from home for 2 nights and 3 days, but I was relieved to see that he had a good time when I picked him up. However, I was concerned that despite it being called socialization training, there was no feedback or anything like that, and it didn't seem to be differentiated from a regular overnight stay. I also requested teeth brushing, but I wasn't given any feedback on that, so I'm a little unsure if they actually did it. The staff were very nice and gentle with the dogs, so I would be very happy if they could reduce the number of dogs they board to make the program more in-depth.

We came here for our dog's grooming.

We switched to this salon because our previous salon moved.

We chose this one because they have a pet hotel, and the photos of the dogs staying there looked like they were having fun.

The location is a bit inconvenient.

It seems like most people come by car.

But dogs keep coming in one after another, so it must be a popular place.

The grooming was great, so we made a reservation for next time!

I'm going on a week-long trip overseas, so I'm heading to Love One, my regular pet hotel!

I often use their Shibaura location, and familiar staff members frequent the store, so I felt at ease leaving my dogs there.

It was my first time at the Ginza location, so my dogs were a bit nervous at first, maybe because they had a stomach ache, but they seemed healthy and happy throughout the trip. 🐶🐶 The photos Love One takes are always amazing. 📷🤣

It's really hard to get a reservation (I recommend making reservations 3-4 months in advance for long-term trips), but considering the service, the amount of playtime your dog gets, and the staff who are willing to walk your dog as close to normal as possible, I think it's an amazing pet hotel!

Even if you're worried about your dog's personality, they offer temporary care, so I recommend using that before considering it.
